projectDescription: GraphQL Yoga API for Application Tracker — a dual REST+GraphQL server built with GraphQL Yoga 5, Pothos code-first schema builder, and Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL. Manages job applications, interview stages, and application history with CSV import/export support. Paired with react-apollo-ui. Runs on port 5080 (graphql_yoga schema).
